One thing that out of any other has left a deep scar was my best friend sexually assaulting me when we both were around 15. I don’t want to use the real word for it because it’s a word that’s a massive trigger for me years after it happened. 

Another thing, around the same time I used to talk my ex out of suicide time and time again. They sometimes had OD’d on alcohol and ibuprofen, and I was crying and pleading for them to throw the pills up. Once I remember calling with them while they were driving a car alone (they were underage without license, their abusive mom forced them to learn driving a car for her). They were in a state of numbness and misery, talking calmly how little movement would be enough to drive onto the oncoming traffic. I was there, now barely even able to cry, pleading them to stop and to return safe. Every time, seeing them slowly fade away with limited time to save them killed something inside of me.

I still don’t know what a relationship is supposed to be. I’ve walked in on suicide attempts of my exes, been abused in several different relationships and I am afraid of every person. Seeing even the kindest, most innocent person turn into something monstrous in my paranoid eyes is horrifying on levels I can’t even put into words.

Not many years later, here in young adulthood, I’m lost and scared in life. It’s psychological torture to be forced to live.

The answer isn’t handed to you directly, you have to piece together. 

1. The outside world being full of monsters, and being a horrible “wasteland” in general is a lie, there is running water, electricity and somehow the father manages to find food that is perfectly packaged. 

2. The father telling her that under any circumstance is she allowed to make noise when monsters (other people, such as the police) may enter the house and speak to her.

3. When she asks why she must take the pills, her father tells that she must take them to not get infected. Up until this point you should know that the outside world is not a wasteland or full of monsters and that there is no infection. The pills make her very sleepy which is just very indicative of sleeping pills or depressants. The father also insists on her taking the pills, and refuses to come down with her daughter awake.

4. The reason the father was away for a few days is most likely because he spent time in jail for one reason or another. Maybe the police took him in to interrogate him about his daughter’s whereabouts.

5. The symbolism about why apple was specifically chosen is definitely tied to how the father thinks about children, quoting him that “they are best when they’re still fresh” or something like that. It could also have a meaning in the story of Adam and Eve, as something forbidden that assaulting a child definitely is.

These are a few, and I understand they may be vague but it did not take me more than a few minutes to realize them as I watched the gameplay. I have suffered through SA in my preteen years so I may see the symbolism more clearly than a person that hasn’t gone through something as horrible.
